program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to relation to multi-step prediction chain
question: Can Wingless compose the source-derived one-step motif relation learned from external prefixes to predict two- and three-step motif futures on untouched external suffixes without training depth-specific programs?
hypothesis: Reuse the exact 512-motif representation, non-overlapping motif stream, one-step conditional relation, fallback, and unigram baseline from WLM-LM-EXTERNAL-MOTIF-RELATION-HOLDOUT-R1. Repeatedly applying only the learned one-step relation will produce positive pooled top-1 accuracy gain over the unigram baseline at both depth two and depth three, with positive gain on at least two of three sources at each depth. Direct depth-specific lookup trained from the same prefixes is diagnostic only and does not participate in composed prediction.

portfolio_context.frontier: external raw bytes -> learned motif representation -> source-derived relation -> multi-step composition

scope_statement: This is bounded multi-step composition of a relation induced from real external byte sequences. It tests whether the learned one-step relation composes predictively; it does not claim semantic or open-domain reasoning.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.source_bytes: same exact verified three-source manifest as relation R1
frozen_reuse.split: same first floor(0.60*N) train / final 40% evaluation split
frozen_reuse.one_step_relation: same 512x512 conditional transition counts and lowest-ID tie break
frozen_reuse.fallback: same pooled next-motif unigram argmax when a state has zero trained outgoing count

composition.prediction: starting from the observed current motif ID, apply the frozen one-step relation predictor exactly depth times; intermediate predictions are fed forward and never corrected from evaluation bytes
composition.evaluation_target: actual motif ID at current_index + depth in the untouched decoded suffix stream
composition.unigram_control: pooled training next-motif unigram argmax predicts the target at every depth
composition.direct_depth_lookup_control: for diagnostics only, train separate current-motif -> motif-at-depth count tables from prefix streams for depth two and three; these controls receive no evaluation updates

diagnostic_metrics: per-source composed, unigram, and direct-depth top-1 accuracy at depth two
per-source composed, unigram, and direct-depth top-1 accuracy at depth three

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and frozen composition thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and at least one depth has positive pooled composed gain while the other depth or source-count threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but composed prediction has no positive pooled gain at either depth.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source identity, split contamination, representation/relation drift, feed-forward composition drift, capacity, determinism, or host-isolation criterion fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, source retrieval, or hosted compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed relation-R1 parent and North Star identities match.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration commit and external manifest.
Representation learning, motif decoding, one-step relation learning, fallback, and unigram baseline are identical to relation R1.
Only prefix streams contribute any training counts; suffix streams are scoring-only.
Composed prediction uses only repeated one-step predictions; actual intermediate suffix motifs are never supplied.
Direct-depth lookup controls are trained from prefix streams only and never feed the composed predictor.
Full Go regression passes before the probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, semantic parser, external model, persistent corpus, capacity growth, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, motif decoding, relation counts, fallback, depths, feed-forward rule, controls, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority requirements after primary output.
